content.comment_body: Operating Manual [product_name] Edition 10/2021 [product_name] provides an Internet connection solution for [product_name] BM, [product_name] SMART CPU, and SMART LINE which now have expanded capabilities for internet interaction. Introduction: The Universal Data Model (UDM) allows [product_name] BM, [product_name] SMART CPU, SMART LINE, and Modbus RTU-compatible devices to map process data centrally. UDM serves as a data center for [product_name], facilitating data exchange through multiple protocols. The 4-port switch enables [product_name] to function as a LAN switch. To ensure stable and efficient operation, [company_name] recommends connecting fewer than 10 devices through Ethernet ports. As a gateway, [product_name] can provide internet access when equipped with a cellular module and SIM card, allowing connected devices to reach the internet. Additional functionalities include: web-based configuration via a browser interface, protocol gateway services allowing connected devices to communicate through S7/Modbus protocol using UDM, RESTful API data access, event-based data management actions such as modifying UDM data or sending messages, mobile data cellular connectivity, GNSS position display and mapping, NTP time server capabilities for distributing time via multi-protocol or RESTful API, and sending power on/off SMS notifications to defined contacts.
There is now a delivery release for the [product_name]. The manual (Edition 10/2021) is available for download again.

analysis.insight_summary: The thread shares an update regarding [product_name] Edition 10/2021, emphasizing its new and existing features. It highlights internet connectivity, web-based configuration, central data management with UDM, and protocol gateway support for various device types. The focus is on available capabilities and the renewed availability of documentation, without user feedback or requests for improvement.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate full firmware functionality as outlined in the manual, smooth protocol integration, access to web-based configuration, and dependable internet connectivity through the [product_name] hardware.
